correctness.rationale: No lines lie in the Veronese surface, so all geometric lines are vertex rulings. A fixed Grassmann chart for the universal line and nine 2x2 symmetric-matrix minors gives D=2tA,E=sA+tB,G=2sB and precisely A²=AB=B²=0, including characteristic 2. The cross-chart change A’=-A, B’=tB-sA is exactly Ω1_{P2}(2) and ruling section splits the extension. The nilradical rank-two bundle c1=H,c2=H² is nontrivial; the Euler sequence gives χ(O(2n))+χ(Ω1(2n+2))=6n²+11n+4, h0=4. Independently rebuilt symbolic nine-minor reduction and Hilbert calculation; structural proof covers all algebraically closed characteristics, not merely numerically tested primes.
